paragraphs: Outset is a medical technology company pioneering a first-of-its-kind technology to improve clinical outcomes in dialysis with less cost and complexity. We believe the Tablo® Hemodialysis System (Tablo) represents a significant technological advancement that transforms the dialysis experience for patients and operationally simplifies it for providers. We designed Tablo from the ground up to be a single enterprise solution that can be utilized across the continuum of care, allowing dialysis to be delivered anytime, anywhere and by virtually anyone. Tablo is currently cleared by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for use in the hospital, clinic or home setting. Our technology is designed to elevate the dialysis experience for patients, and help providers overcome traditional care delivery challenges. Our focus on flexibility, ease of use, data analytics and user experience translates to meaningfully reduced training times and fixed infrastructure requirements. Requiring only an electrical outlet and tap water to operate, Tablo frees patients and providers from the burdensome infrastructure required to operate traditional dialysis machines. The integration of water purification and on-demand dialysate production in a single 35-inch compact console enables Tablo to provide clinical and operational flexibility to customers. Tablo leverages cloud technology, making it possible for providers to monitor devices and treatments remotely, perform patient and population analytics and automate clinical recordkeeping. With a simple-to-use touchscreen interface, two-way wireless data transmission and a proprietary data analytics platform, Tablo is a new holistic approach to dialysis care. Unlike traditional hemodialysis machines, which have limited clinical versatility across care settings, Tablo can be used seamlessly across multiple care settings and a wide range of clinical applications.

We have generated meaningful evidence to demonstrate that providers can realize significant operational efficiencies, including reducing the cost of their dialysis programs. In addition, Tablo has been shown to deliver robust clinical care. In studies and surveys we have conducted, patients have reported quality of life benefits on Tablo compared to other dialysis machines. We believe Tablo empowers patients, who have traditionally been passive recipients of care, to regain agency and ownership of their treatment.

Kidney failure can be temporary and occur spontaneously due to an underlying medical condition, as is the case in acute kidney injury (AKI), or can worsen gradually over time, as is the case in chronic kidney disease (CKD), which may result in end-stage renal disease (ESRD). Kidney failure is commonly managed with hemodialysis, a procedure by which waste products and excess fluid are directly removed from a patient's blood using an external dialysis machine. ESRD patients require complex management and the cost burden of administering dialysis is significant. Hemodialysis can be performed in multiple care settings, including the hospital, clinic or the patient's home. Typically, different types of dialysis machines are used in different care settings and for different clinical needs. Tablo is an enterprise dialysis solution that allows providers to standardize to a single technology platform.

Driving adoption of Tablo in the acute setting has been our primary focus since Tablo's clearance by the FDA for use in an acute or chronic care facility. We have experience helping nearly 1,000 acute-care facilities, with the goal of making dialysis financially, operationally and clinically better.

We support hospitals with our expertise, technology, data and analytics, electronic-health-record integration, dedicated service infrastructure, clinical insights and dialysis know-how to help stand up, take to scale and maintain an insourced dialysis service line. By standing up an insourced dialysis service line, certain of our customers have reported saving millions of dollars, reducing central-line blood stream infection rates, reducing length of stay in the intensive care unit (ICU), improving accreditation compliance, and improving nurse satisfaction and retention.

We have invested in growing our economic and clinical evidence, built field service, sales and clinical support teams with significant expertise, and implemented a comprehensive training and customer experience program. Our experience in the acute market has demonstrated Tablo's clinical flexibility and operational versatility, while also delivering meaningful cost savings to the providers. In addition, we are working with skilled nursing facilities (SNFs), long-term acute care hospitals (LTACHs), and other post-acute providers to raise awareness of Tablo's economic and clinical benefits to them and to patients. We plan to continue leveraging our commercial infrastructure, including our sales, field service and marketing teams, to broaden our installed base in the acute and post-acute care markets, as well as driving utilization and fleet expansion with our existing customers.

Tablo is also utilized for home-based dialysis. In 2020, Tablo was cleared by the FDA for patient use in the home. We believe our ability to reduce training time, patient dropout, and supplies and infrastructure required to deliver dialysis in the home can drive efficiency and economic improvements to the home care model. In our home investigational device exemption (IDE) trial, patients reported specific quality of life improvements compared to their experience on the incumbent home dialysis machine. To demonstrate the cost advantages of Tablo in the home setting, we are continuing to collect additional patient clinical experience and outcomes data.

Tablo is an FDA-cleared single enterprise solution for hemodialysis, comprised of a compact console with integrated water purification, on-demand dialysate production and advanced software and connectivity capabilities. We designed Tablo from the ground up to be a single enterprise solution that can be utilized across the continuum of care, allowing dialysis to be delivered anytime, anywhere, and by virtually anyone. Unlike traditional hemodialysis machines, Tablo can be used seamlessly across multiple care settings and a wide range of clinical applications, all with the benefit of remote system management, monitoring and maintenance through two-way wireless data transmission capabilities.
Tablo is comprised of the following components:

• Tablo Console. A proprietary, compact, mobile and versatile machine consisting of an integrated water purification, on-demand dialysate production system and simple-to-use touchscreen interface with 3D animations that guide the user through treatment from start to finish. Using advanced sensors, the console automates much of treatment setup and management and can automatically self-diagnose for potential machine issues. Tablo console can accommodate a wide range of treatment modalities, durations and flow rates, allowing for broad clinical applications. Tablo console requires only a standard electrical outlet and tap water to operate. This eliminates the need for industrial water treatment rooms, separate water purification machines and pre-filled bags of dialysate associated with traditional dialysis machines. We also offer TabloCart with Prefiltration drawer or storage drawer, an accessory for Tablo, that is configured based on the customer's needs.

• Tablo Cartridge. A proprietary, disposable single use pre-strung cartridge that easily clicks into place, minimizing steps, touch points and connections, allowing for set up of treatment supplies in less than 12 minutes. Tablo cartridge was designed to simplify and streamline treatment setup to minimize the potential for user error. Tablo cartridge is intended to facilitate extracorporeal blood purification for patients. One cartridge is used per treatment, except in the case of extended therapy, where multiple cartridges can be used if needed. Tablo cartridge consists of a user-friendly pre-configured blood, saline, and infusion tubing. Tablo cartridge requires only two connections to operate as compared to other machines that require stringing, hanging, snapping and tapping multiple lines. In our home IDE trial, patients were able to set up Tablo cartridge and dialysate concentrates in less than 12 minutes, on average. With an average prime period of approximately eight minutes, an uninterrupted patient can initiate therapy in as little as around 20 minutes, representing a significant improvement over traditional machines, which can take approximately 45 minutes to set up.

• Tablo Data Ecosystem. As further described below in the section entitled "Tablo Data Ecosystem", with Tablo, we are bringing data to dialysis. Tablo is built to live in a connected setting with cloud-based system monitoring, patient analytics and clinical recordkeeping.

Tablo's two-way wireless data transmission and connectedness help reduce maintenance costs and enable ongoing system improvements. This is all made possible by our team of experienced software, data science, and machine learning engineers.

Tablo leverages cloud technology to make it possible for providers to monitor devices remotely, view treatment data, perform patient and population analytics, and automate clinical recordkeeping. Tablo's wireless connectivity enables us to release training, new features, and enhancements over-the-air (OTA) without interventions by field service engineers (FSEs). This means that customers can train and upgrade their device on their own schedule. We use these OTA updates to add new features designed to extend Tablo's clinical applicability and enhance device uptime. We believe these OTA updates help Tablo get smarter over time.

paragraphs: The following summarizes the principal factors that make an investment in our company speculative or risky, all of which are more fully described in the risk factors section below. This summary should be read in conjunction with the risk factors section and should not be relied upon as an exhaustive summary of the material risks facing our business. The following factors could result in harm to our business, reputation, revenue, financial results, and prospects, among other impacts:
• Our history of net losses and expectation that we will continue to incur losses;
• Our ability to achieve sustainable gross margins, including by reducing manufacturing and service costs;
• Our ability to attain market acceptance for Tablo among providers and patients;
• Concentration of our revenues in a single product and concentration of a large percentage of our revenues from a limited number of customers;
• Financial pressures faced by our customers including capital budget constraints, staffing shortages and increased costs;

paragraphs: The following discussion of our financial condition and results of operations is expected to better allow investors to view the Company from management's perspective and should be read together with our audited financial statements and related notes and other financial information included elsewhere in this Annual Report. The following discussion contains forward-looking statements that reflect our current plans, estimates and beliefs. Our actual results could differ materially from those discussed in the forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those discussed below and elsewhere in this Annual Report, particularly in the section titled "Risk Factors." Our historical results are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected for any period in the future.

We have elected to omit discussion of the earliest of the three years covered by the audited financial statements presented. Refer to Part II, Item 7, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations", located in our annual report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024 for reference to discussion of the year ended December 31, 2024, the earliest of the three fiscal years presented.

Our technology is designed to elevate the dialysis experience for patients and help providers overcome traditional care delivery challenges. Requiring only an electrical outlet and tap water to operate, our Tablo® Hemodialysis System (Tablo) frees patients and providers from the burdensome infrastructure required to operate traditional dialysis machines. The integration of water purification and on-demand dialysate production in a single 35-inch compact console enables Tablo to provide clinical and operational flexibility to customers. With a simple-to-use touchscreen interface, two-way wireless data transmission and a proprietary data analytics platform, Tablo is a holistic approach to dialysis care. Unlike existing hemodialysis machines, which have limited clinical versatility across care settings, Tablo can be used seamlessly across multiple care settings and a wide range of clinical applications. Tablo is cleared by the FDA for use in the hospital, clinic, or home setting.

Tablo leverages cloud technology, making it possible for providers to monitor devices remotely, view treatment data, perform patient and population analytics, and automate clinical recordkeeping. Tablo's wireless connectivity enables us to release training, new features and enhancements over-the-air without interventions by FSEs. Tablo's connectedness allows continuous streaming of an average of approximately 3 million machine performance data points to the cloud for every treatment. We use this data, in conjunction with our diagnostic and predictive algorithms, to monitor device performance, identify and diagnose failures and, in some instances, predict and prevent potential future device failures or malfunctions. In effect, this contributes to a reduction in service hours and an increase in device uptime.

We have generated meaningful evidence to demonstrate that providers can realize significant operational efficiencies, including reducing the cost of their dialysis programs. In addition, Tablo has been shown to deliver robust clinical care. In studies and surveys we have conducted, patients have reported quality of life benefits on Tablo compared to other dialysis machines. We believe Tablo empowers patients, who have traditionally been passive recipients of care, to regain agency and ownership of their treatment.

Driving adoption of Tablo in the acute care setting has been our primary focus to date. We have invested in growing our economic and clinical evidence, built a veteran sales and clinical support team with significant expertise, and implemented a comprehensive training and customer experience program. Our experience in the acute care market has demonstrated Tablo's clinical flexibility and operational versatility, while also delivering meaningful cost savings to the providers. In addition, we are also working with SNFs, LTACHs, and other post-acute providers to raise awareness of Tablo's economic and clinical benefits to them and to patients. We plan to continue leveraging our commercial infrastructure to broaden our installed base in the acute and post-acute care markets, as well as driving utilization and fleet expansion with our existing customers.

Tablo is also utilized for home-based dialysis. We believe our ability to reduce training time, patient dropout, and the supplies and infrastructure required to deliver dialysis in the home can drive efficiency and economic improvements to the home care model. In our home IDE trial, patients reported specific quality of life improvements compared to their experience on the incumbent home dialysis machine. To penetrate this market successfully, we have made investments in and continue to focus on refining our home distribution, logistics and support systems to help ensure they are ready for scale.

We generate revenue from the placement of Tablo consoles along with accessories, and shipping and handling charged to customers, which revenue is recognized up-front. For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, sales of our consoles, which includes Tablo consoles and accessories, accounted for 26%, 26% and 47% of our revenue, respectively. We also earn recurring revenue from sales of consumables, including Tablo cartridge, and services, which generates significant total revenue over the life of Tablo console. For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, sales of our consumables accounted for 45%, 45% and 32% of our revenue, respectively, and sales of service and other accounted for 29%, 29% and 21% of our revenue, respectively.

We primarily sell our solutions through our direct sales organization, which covers most major metropolitan markets in the United States. Our sales organization is comprised of our capital sales team, responsible for generating new customer demand for Tablo, and our clinical sales team, responsible for driving utilization and fleet expansion of Tablo at existing customer sites. In

addition, our field service team provides maintenance services and product support to our customers. Our field sales and service teams represent 58% of our total full-time employees as of December 31, 2025. The same sales organization and field service team drive Tablo penetration in both the acute and home markets. We believe the ability to leverage one team to serve both markets will result in significant productivity and cost optimization as we continue to scale our business.

We believe that our financial performance has been, and in the foreseeable future will continue to be, primarily driven by the following factors. While we believe each of these factors presents significant opportunities for our business, they also pose important challenges that we must successfully address in order to sustain our growth and improve our results of operations. Our ability to successfully address the factors below is subject to various risks and uncertainties, including those described in the section titled "Risk Factors."

We plan to further broaden our installed base by continuing to target national and regional integrated delivery networks and health systems, SNFs, LTACHs and other post-acute providers. In addition, we focus on driving utilization and fleet expansion with existing customers by providing an exceptional user experience delivered through our commercial team and a steady release of software enhancements that amplify Tablo's operational reliability and clinical versatility. Our ability to successfully execute on this strategy, and thereby increase our revenue in the acute market, will depend on several factors. These factors include the success of our initiatives to optimize and further evolve our commercial organization, infrastructure and sales processes to support the growth of our business in the acute and post-acute care markets as we focus more heavily on enterprise selling and transition beyond earlier stage adoption of Tablo.

We believe that a significant growth opportunity exists within the home hemodialysis market. We are partnering with innovative dialysis clinic providers, health systems and other adjacent healthcare providers who are motivated to grow their home hemodialysis population, and who share our vision of creating a seamless and supported transition to the home. We are also investing in market development over the longer term to expand the home hemodialysis market itself. The expansion of the home hemodialysis market and our ability to penetrate this market will be an important factor in driving the future growth of our business. In addition, the success of our efforts to expand within the home market, help grow new home programs and increase our revenue generated from home-based dialysis on the timeline that we anticipate will depend on several factors. These factors include the success of our initiatives to optimize and further evolve our commercial organization, infrastructure and sales processes as we scale our business in the home market.

Our ability to expand our gross margins depends on: first, our ability to continue to sell Tablo cartridges, services, and accessories for Tablo consoles; second, our ability to reduce the cost of service and third, our ability to reduce the cost to manufacture Tablo consoles. Our ability to expand gross margins will also depend in part on our ability to control the average selling prices of our products and services, including by selling higher-margin accessories, consumables and services. Further, we will continue to utilize our cloud-based data system, as well as enhanced product and support performance, to improve service margin and drive down service costs per console. In addition, over the past several years, we have moved the production of Tablo consoles and a substantial majority of Tablo cartridges in-house to our manufacturing facility in Tijuana, Mexico which we operate in collaboration with TACNA, as part of our cost reduction activities. This has helped further our long-term gross margin expansion and supply continuity strategies while reducing the costs of Tablo console production and improving the flexibility of our operations. We will continue our cost reduction activities by using our design, engineering, supply chain and manufacturing capabilities to help further advance and improve the efficiency of our manufacturing processes, lowering the cost of parts and components and lowering our costs of production. Our ability to expand gross margins depends on our ability to successfully execute these strategies, as well as the impact of macroeconomic factors described below, including the tariffs imposed by the current administration.

Outset 是一家醫療科技公司，開發了首創的技術，以較低的成本和複雜度改善透析的臨牀結果。我們認為 Tablo® 血液透析系統（Tablo）代表了一項重要的技術進步，能改變病患的透析經驗，並簡化醫療機構的運作。我們從零開始設計 Tablo，使其成為一個企業級解決方案，可用於照護的整個過程，讓透析可在任何時間、任何地點，由幾乎任何人進行。Tablo 目前已獲得美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）核准，可用於醫院、診所或居家環境。我們的技術旨在提升病患的透析經驗，並協助醫療機構克服傳統照護的挑戰。我們對靈活性、易用性、資料分析和使用者體驗的重視，使培訓時間大幅減少，並降低固定基礎設施需求。Tablo 只需電源插座和來水即可運作，使病患和醫療機構無需面對傳統透析機所需的繁重基礎設施。將水淨化和按需製造透析液整合在一個 35 吋緊湊的控制檯中，使 Tablo 能為客戶提供臨牀和運作上的靈活性。Tablo 優化雲端技術，使醫療機構能遠端監測設備和治療，進行病患和羣體資料分析，並自動化臨牀記錄。透過簡單易用的觸控螢幕介面、雙向無線資料傳輸和專有資料分析平台，Tablo 提供了一種全新的整體透析照護方式。與傳統血液透析機相比，Tablo 在不同照護環境中具有較高的臨牀靈活性，可無縫地應用於多種照護環境和廣泛的臨牀應用。
我們已產生具體證據，證明醫療機構可實現顯著的運作效率，包括降低其透析計畫的成本。此外，Tablo 已被證明能提供強大的臨牀照護。根據我們進行的研究和問卷調查，病患在使用 Tablo 相較於其他透析機時，報告了生活品質的改善。我們認為 Tablo 能賦予病患主導權，使他們重新掌握治療的主動權。

腎衰竭可能是暫時性的，因基礎醫療狀況而突然發生，如急性腎損傷（AKI），也可能逐漸惡化，如慢性腎臟病（CKD），這可能導致末期腎臟病（ESRD）。腎衰竭通常透過血液透析來管理，這是一種透過外部透析機直接從病患血液中去除廢物和過多液體的程序。ESRD 病患需要複雜的管理，並進行透析的費用負擔相當沉重。血液透析可在多種照護環境中進行，包括醫院、診所或病患的家中。通常，不同類型的透析機會用於不同照護環境和不同臨牀需求。Tablo 是一個企業級的透析解決方案，使醫療機構能標準化至單一技術平台。
自 Tablo 獲得 FDA 核准用於急性或慢性照護機構以來，我們的主要重點是推動 Tablo 在急性環境中的採用。我們有經驗協助近 1,000 家急性照護機構，目標是使透析在財務、運作和臨牀方面變得更好。
我們以專業知識、技術、資料和分析、電子病歷整合、專屬服務基礎設施、臨牀見解和透析專業知識支援醫院，協助建立、擴展並維持內設的透析服務線。透過建立內設的透析服務線，我們的一些客戶已報告節省數百萬美元，降低中心靜脈導管血流感染率，減少重症加護病房（ICU）的住院天數，改善認證合規性，並提高護理師的滿意度和留任率。

我們已投資於擴大我們的經濟和臨牀證據，建立具有豐富經驗的現場服務、銷售和臨牀支援團隊，並實施完整的培訓和客戶體驗計畫。我們在急性市場的經驗已證明 Tablo 的臨牀靈活性和運作適應性，同時也為醫療機構帶來顯著的成本節省。此外，我們正與專業護理機構（SNFs）、長期急性照護醫院（LTACHs）及其他後續照護提供者合作，提高他們和病患對 Tablo 經濟和臨牀效益的認知。我們計畫繼續利用我們的商業基礎設施，包括銷售、現場服務和行銷團隊，擴大我們在急性和後續照護市場的裝機量，並推動現有客戶的使用率和裝備擴充。
Tablo 也用於居家透析。2020 年，Tablo 獲得 FDA 核准，可用於病患在家中使用。我們相信我們能減少培訓時間、病患流失以及在家中提供透析所需的供應品和基礎設施，進而提高居家照護模式的效率和經濟效益。在我們的居家臨牀試驗（IDE）中，病患報告了與使用現有居家透析機相比，有特定的生活品質改善。為證明 Tablo 在居家環境中的成本優勢，我們正持續收集更多病患的臨牀經驗和結果資料。

Tablo 是一款經 FDA 核准的單一企業級解決方案，用於血液透析，包含一個整合水淨化、按需製造透析液和先進軟體及連線功能的緊湊控制檯。我們從零開始設計 Tablo，使其成為一個企業級解決方案，可用於照護的整個過程，讓透析可在任何時間、任何地點，由幾乎任何人進行。與傳統血液透析機不同，Tablo 可無縫地應用於多種照護環境和廣泛的臨牀應用，並透過雙向無線資料傳輸功能提供遠端系統管理、監測和維護的優勢。
Tablo 由以下零組件組成：

• Tablo Console。為一項專利的緊湊、移動性佳且靈活的機器，包含整合式水淨化、按需製造透析液的系統，以及簡單易用的觸控螢幕介面，搭配 3D 動畫引導使用者從開始到結束的治療過程。透過先進的感測器，此機臺可自動化許多治療設定與管理，並可自動診斷潛在的機器問題。Tablo Console 可適應廣泛的治療模式、時間長度與流速，允許廣泛的臨牀應用。Tablo Console 只需標準電源插座與自來水即可運作。這消除了傳統透析機器所需的工業水處理室、獨立水淨化機器與預裝填的透析液袋。我們也提供 TabloCart，搭配預過濾抽屜或儲存抽屜，為 Tablo 的配件，根據客戶需求進行配置。

• Tablo Cartridge。為一項專利的單次使用、預裝置的過濾 cartridge，輕鬆點擊即可安裝，減少步驟、觸點與連接，使治療用品的設定時間少於 12 分鐘。Tablo Cartridge 設計用以簡化與流線化治療設定，以降低使用者錯誤的潛在風險。Tablo Cartridge 旨在協助患者進行體外血液淨化。每次治療使用一個 cartridge，除非是延長治療，則在需要時可使用多個 cartridge。Tablo Cartridge 包含用戶友好的預配置血液、生理鹽水與輸液管路。Tablo Cartridge 運作只需兩個連接點，與其他機器需要串接、懸掛、扣接與點擊多條線路相比，大幅簡化。在我們的居家 IDE 試驗中，患者平均可在 12 分鐘內完成 Tablo Cartridge 與透析濃縮液的設定。平均預熱時間約為八分鐘，無中斷的患者可在大約 20 分鐘內啟動治療，這比起傳統機器需要約 45 分鐘的設定時間，有顯著的改善。
• Tablo Data Ecosystem。如後述「Tablo Data Ecosystem」節所述，透過 Tablo，我們將數據引入透析領域。Tablo 設計為在連線環境中運作，包含雲端系統監測、患者分析與臨牀記錄功能。
Tablo 的雙向無線數據傳輸與連線功能有助於降低維護成本，並實現系統的持續改進。這一切皆因我們經驗豐富的軟體、數據科學與機器學習工程師團隊所實現。

Tablo 藉助雲端技術，使供應商能遠端監測設備、查看治療數據、進行患者與羣體分析，並自動化臨牀記錄。Tablo 的無線連線功能使我們能透過空中更新（OTA）發佈訓練、新功能與改進，而無需現場工程師（FSEs）的幹預。這意味著客戶可依照自己的排程進行設備的訓練與升級。我們利用這些 OTA 更新來增加新功能，以擴展 Tablo 的臨牀應用範疇並提升設備運作時間。我們認為這些 OTA 更新有助於 Tablo 隨時間推移變得更智能。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論，預期將有助投資人從管理階層的觀點來瞭解本公司，應與我們經審計的財務報表及相關附註，以及其他財務資訊一併閱讀。以下討論包含向前看的陳述，反映我們目前的計畫、預估與信念。我們的實際結果可能與向前看陳述中所討論的結果有重大差異，原因可能是多種因素，包括下文及本年度報告其他部分所討論的那些因素，特別是在「風險因素」一節中。我們的歷史結果未必能代表未來任何一段期間的結果。
我們已決定省略經審計財務報表所涵蓋的最早三個會計年度中的最早年度。請參閱我們於2024年12月31日財務年度所提交的10-K年度報告，其中的第二部分，第7項「管理層對財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析」，以參考有關2024年12月31日財務年度的討論，這是所呈現的三個會計年度中最早的一個。

我們的技術設計用以提升病患的透析經驗，並協助提供者克服傳統照護交付的挑戰。Tablo® Hemodialysis System（Tablo）僅需電源插座與水龍頭即可運作，使病患與提供者免除傳統透析機所需的繁重基礎建設。將水純化與按需製造透析液整合於單一35寸緊湊控制檯中，使Tablo能為客戶提供臨牀與運作上的靈活性。搭配簡單易用的觸控螢幕介面、雙向無線資料傳輸與專利資料分析平台，Tablo是透析照護的整體解決方案。與現有血液透析機相比，Tablo可在多種照護環境與廣泛的臨牀應用中順暢使用。Tablo已獲得FDA核准，可用於醫院、診所或居家環境。

Tablo運用雲端技術，使提供者能遠端監控裝置、查看治療資料、執行病患與羣體分析，並自動化臨牀紀錄。Tablo的無線連線功能使我們能透過空中更新發佈培訓、新功能與升級，而無需現場工程師的幹預。Tablo的連線性使我們能持續將每治療次數平均約3百萬個裝置運作資料點傳送到雲端。我們利用這些資料，配合我們的診斷與預測演算法，監控裝置運作狀況、識別與診斷故障，並在某些情況下預測與防止潛在的未來裝置故障或失靈。換句話說，這有助於減少服務時數並提高裝置運作時間。
我們已產生具體證據，證明提供者可以實現顯著的運作效率，包括降低其透析計畫的成本。此外，Tablo已被證明能提供強大的臨牀照護。根據我們進行的研究與問卷調查，病患在使用Tablo與其他透析機相比，報告了生活品質的改善。我們認為Tablo賦予病患，這些傳統上是被動接受照護的個體，重新獲得對治療的主導權與擁有權。

推動Tablo在急性照護環境中的採用，是我們迄今為止的主要重點。我們已投資於擴大我們的經濟與臨牀證據，建立了一支經驗豐富的銷售與臨牀支援團隊，並實施了一套完整的培訓與客戶體驗計畫。我們在急性照護市場的經驗已證明Tablo的臨牀靈活性與運作多樣性，同時也為提供者帶來顯著的成本節省。此外，我們也與SNFs、LTACHs及其他後續照護提供者合作，提高他們與病患對Tablo經濟與臨牀效益的認知。我們計畫持續利用我們的商業基礎設施，擴大在急性與後續照護市場的裝置安裝基礎，同時推動現有客戶的使用率與裝置擴充。
Tablo也用於居家透析。我們相信我們能減少培訓時間、病患流失以及在家中提供透析所需的供應品與基礎設施，這有助於提高居家照護模式的效率與經濟效益。在我們的居家IDE試驗中，病患報告了與使用現有居家透析機相比，具體的生活品質改善。為成功進入這個市場，我們已投資並持續專注於優化我們的居家配送、物流與支援系統，以確保這些系統能準備好進行規模擴張。

我們從放置Tablo控制檯與配件，以及向客戶收取的運費中產生收入，這些收入在交易時即認列。截至2025年12月31日、2024年12月31日及2023年12月31日財務年度，我們控制檯的銷售，包括Tablo控制檯與配件，分別佔我們收入的26%、26%及47%。我們也從消耗品（包括Tablo cartridges）與服務的銷售中產生重複性收入，這在Tablo控制檯的使用期間會產生顯著的總收入。截至2025年12月31日、2024年12月31日及2023年12月31日財務年度，我們消耗品的銷售分別佔我們收入的45%、45%及32%，而服務及其他銷售則分別佔29%、29%及21%。
我們主要透過我們的直接銷售團隊銷售解決方案，該團隊覆蓋美國大多數主要都會區市場。我們的銷售團隊由負責產生 Tablo 新客戶需求的資本銷售團隊，以及負責在現有客戶場域推動 Tablo 使用率與車隊擴張的臨牀銷售團隊組成。在
此外，我們的現場服務團隊為客戶提供維護服務與產品支援。我們的現場銷售與服務團隊截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，佔我們總全職員工數的 58%。相同的銷售團隊與現場服務團隊驅動 Tablo 在急診與居家市場的滲透率。我們認為能透過一個團隊服務兩個市場，將會帶來顯著的生產力與成本優化，隨著我們持續擴張業務。
我們認為，我們的財務表現已受到，且在可預見的未來將持續受到以下因素的驅動。雖然我們認為這些因素對我們的業務而言都具有重要的成長機會，但它們同時也帶來我們必須成功應對的重要挑戰，以維持我們的成長並改善我們的營運結果。我們成功應對以下因素的能力，受到各種風險與不確定性影響，包括在「風險因素」一節中所描述的風險。

我們計畫透過持續針對國家與區域整合式服務網路與醫療系統、SNFs、LTACHs 及其他後急診服務提供者，來進一步擴大我們的裝置基礎。此外，我們也著重於透過商業團隊提供卓越的用戶體驗，以及持續發佈軟體升級，來推動現有客戶的使用率與車隊擴張。我們成功執行此策略，並因此增加急診市場的營收的能力，將取決於多種因素。這些因素包括我們在優化並進一步發展商業組織、基礎建設與銷售流程方面的努力，以支持我們在急診與後急診照護市場的業務成長，而我們將更重視企業銷售，並超越早期階段的 Tablo 採用。

我們認為在居家血液透析市場存在顯著的成長機會。我們正與創新血液透析診所提供者、醫療系統及其他相關醫療提供者合作，這些提供者希望擴大其居家血液透析人口，並與我們共享創造順暢且受支持的居家過渡的願景。我們也正在進行長期的市場發展投資，以擴大居家血液透析市場本身。居家血液透析市場的擴張以及我們滲透該市場的能力，將是推動我們業務未來成長的重要因素。此外，我們在居家市場的擴張努力、協助成長新的居家計畫，以及在預期時間表內增加來自居家透析的營收，將取決於多種因素。這些因素包括我們在優化並進一步發展商業組織、基礎建設與銷售流程方面的努力，以支持我們在居家市場擴張業務。

我們擴大毛利率的能力取決於：第一，我們持續銷售 Tablo 電 cartridge、服務與 Tablo 控制檯配件的能力；第二，我們降低服務成本的能力；第三，我們降低 Tablo 控制檯製造成本的能力。我們擴大毛利率的能力也部分取決於我們控制產品與服務平均售價的能力，包括透過銷售高毛利率的配件、消耗品與服務。此外，我們將持續利用我們的雲端資料系統，以及增強的產品與支援表現，以提高服務毛利率並降低每臺控制檯的服務成本。此外，在過去幾年，我們已將 Tablo 控制檯與大量 Tablo 電 cartridge 的生產轉移至我們位於墨西哥提華納的製造廠，該廠與 TACNA 合作運作，作為我們成本降低活動的一部分。這有助於我們長期毛利率擴張與供應鏈連續性的策略，同時降低 Tablo 控制檯的生產成本並提高我們的作業靈活性。我們將持續進行成本降低活動，透過設計、工程、供應鏈與製造能力，協助進一步提升與改善我們的製造流程效率，降低零件與零組件的成本，並降低我們的生產成本。我們擴大毛利率的能力取決於我們成功執行這些策略的能力，以及下面所描述的總體經濟因素的影響，包括當前政府所施加的關稅。

paragraphs: 以下總結了使投資本公司之行為具備投機性或風險性之主要因素，所有因素皆於下文風險因素部分有更詳細說明。此摘要應與風險因素部分一併閱讀，不得單獨依賴作為本公司面臨重大風險之完整總結。以下因素可能會對本公司之業務、聲譽、營業收入、財務表現及前景等造成損害，及其他影響：
• 本公司歷來之淨虧損歷史及預期將持續產生虧損；
• 本公司達成可持續毛利率之能力，包括透過降低製造及服務成本；
• 本公司獲得Tablo產品於供應商及患者之間市場接受度之能力；
• 本公司收入集中於單一產品，且來自極少數客戶之收入佔比極高；
• 本公司客戶所面臨之財務壓力，包括資本預算限制、人力不足及成本增加；
